plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 20% and QQQ to 10% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 15%, to favor income and broad index exposure.
Trim CRWD to 10% to reduce single name concentration.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan aims for a target of ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation and low drawdown. It significantly reduces leverage and concentration, leading to a more stable but potentially lower-growth portfolio.

plan: Trim SOXL to 3% and SPAL to 1% to reduce leveraged ETF exposure.
Trim SPY to 25% and QQQ to 10% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.
Sell SMH to zero as it is flagged by the exit scanner.
Buy SNOW at 4% as a strong scanner setup to add quality tech exposure.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small amount of leverage.
balanced.read: This balanced plan targets ~2.5% per month, focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall concentration and leverage while introducing a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate drawdowns with a focus on sustainable growth.

plan: Add to SOXL and SPAL, bringing each to 6%, to increase leveraged ETF exposure.
Buy SNOW at 6% and MSFT at 5% as strong scanner setups to concentrate in high-scoring names.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.
Sell SMH to zero as it is flagged by the exit scanner.
This plan leans into leverage and concentration for aggressive growth.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth by utilizing leveraged ETFs and concentrating in high-scoring setups. Be aware that this approach significantly increases both upside potential and drawdown risk, and leveraged ETFs are subject to daily decay and rebalancing.

plan: Sell SOXL and SPAL to zero to eliminate all leveraged ETF exposure.
Add to QQQI, bringing it to 30%, to prioritize income and covered-call ETFs.
Trim SPY to 20% to reduce broad index concentration and meet mandate limits.
Sell QQQ and CRWD to zero to reduce growth-oriented and high-beta single names.
This plan focuses on generating steady monthly distributions with low drawdown.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield through income and covered-call ETFs. While prioritizing low drawdown and reliable distributions, remember that distributions are variable and NAV can still fall in a selloff. This is not a savings account.
